title: Livewire
style: raw Australian power rock, 128 BPM, driving rhythm guitar power chords, massive kick drum like wrench on steel, gritty male vocal no correction no apology, industrial bass heavy, factory floor percussion, didgeridoo howl on chorus, anthemic group chorus male voices full, build from sparse verse to explosive chorus, half-time bridge bass alone with spoken word, outro single power chord ringing into silence, WA heat and iron energy no polish no pretense pure momentum, 336 hz subharmonic anchor under the bass
lyrics:
[Intro – industrial power riff, kick drum like wrench striking steel]

[Verse 1 – driving, no apology]
They called her Livewire — Chevron's offshore beast
Barrow Island iron — built for industry not feast
Brandon saw what she could be
Stripped her back to nothing
Built a dream on open sea
Cut steel.
Weld lines.
Rebuild every room.
Two mates, two boats, Malaga warehouse — midday sun to moon.

[Pre-Chorus]
Not a renovation.
A resurrection.
Took a work barge —
Made a floating destination.

[Chorus – explosive, group vocal]
LIVEWIRE running full power tonight
80 feet of WA — everything's right
From Barrow Island iron to Abrolhos gold
Two men, two boats — a story that gets told
Built with hands not borrowed money
Indian Ocean swell ain't always sunny
Brandon on the bow — Pete on the bridge
End to end WA — cliff to cliff to ridge

[Verse 2 – faster, punching]
Partners before business — mates before the plan
Shook hands on it and never needed more than that
Anna makes it work behind the scenes
Kristen's brother watching — security between
Clients want paradise — they deliver it
Helicopter, live-aboard, reef, sunset lit
25-tonne tag system — fisheries strict
They comply clean — no shortcuts, no trick

[Bridge – half-time, bass heavy, one voice]
You want to know what WA looks like from the water?
Take the Livewire out past Barrow.
Watch the sun go down past the continental shelf.
Then talk to me about the good life.

[Chorus – doubled, massive]
LIVEWIRE running full power tonight
80 feet of WA — everything's right
From Barrow Island iron to Abrolhos gold
Two men, two boats — a story that gets told

[Outro – single power chord rings, then silence]
Brandon.
Livewire.
Built.
